name: Shriram Finance Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest used-commercial-vehicle financier and a major lender to small road-transport operators, MSMEs, two-wheelers, gold and personal loans. AUM above Rs 3.3 lakh cr (Q2 FY27), consolidated borrowings Rs 2.36 lakh cr (bank loans, NCDs, public deposits, ECBs), financing margin ~37%. Japan's MUFG took ~20% stake via preferential allotment (about US$4.4bn per Outlook Business 2026-08-26). Q2 FY27 PAT Rs 3,684 cr (+59% YoY) but gross/net Stage 3 rose and growth guidance was cut on monsoon/El Nino risk.

revenue_mix.segment: MSME, gold, personal and other loans

exposures.mechanism: Borrowings Rs 2.36 lakh cr (Sep-26 screener). Assume ~40% floating/repo-MCLR-linked (model assumption) -> +25bp = Rs 236 cr/yr vs annualised financing profit ~Rs 20,400 cr = -1.2% pre-pass-through; vehicle loans are fixed-rate so only partial repricing, and ~half of the repo move is absorbed in 12m. Add discount-rate effect on P/E 17.9: -1.3% from a ~+2% higher cost of equity per 25bp. Persistence 0.5, EV/MCap ~1 (lender) -> about -2.5. Empirical pack has no repo series.

evidence.note: RBI MPC hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance calibrated tightening (Reuters/The Hindu headlines)
Q2 FY27 PAT +59% YoY; gross/net Stage 3 up; brokerages cut targets, stock -10% in 2 days (CNBC TV18, ET, Business Standard headlines)

exposures.mechanism: 10y G-sec +25bp lifts NCD/bank-loan benchmark yields and cost of equity; Shriram holds only Rs 19,397 cr investments (5% of assets) so treasury MTM is small. Valuation effect ~ -1.5% per 25bp at P/E 18.

exposures.mechanism: NCDs/ECBs ~25% of borrowings (model knowledge; ~Rs 59k cr) reprice on spread widening: +50bp x Rs 59k cr = Rs 295 cr/yr = -1.5% of financing profit; AAA-rated so spread beta ~0.7; plus risk-premium on equity. Persistence 0.5 -> -2.5.

exposures.mechanism: +50bp credit cost on AUM ~Rs 3.3 lakh cr (Investing.com headline: AUM > Rs 3.3 tn) = Rs 1,650 cr/yr vs annualised PBT ~Rs 19,700 cr = -8% PAT; persistence 0.5, EV/MCap 1 -> -4.2; Q2 FY27 gross and net Stage 3 rose and management flagged higher near-term credit cost (CNBC TV18, TradingView headlines, 2026-10-23).

exposures.mechanism: Rural/semi-urban truckers, small traders and farm-linked borrowers drive collections; Shriram cut growth guidance citing El Nino risk to rural repayment capacity (bfsi.economictimes 2026-10-27). +10% rainfall above LPA -> lower stage-2 formation and ~+1pp AUM growth: +2.

evidence.note: guidance cut tied to El Nino / monsoon (headline only)

exposures.mechanism: Used and new CV financing is the core franchise (new-vehicle mix target 20-25%, ET BFSI 2026-10-01). +10% vehicle volumes -> ~+4pp AUM growth ~+3% earnings over 12m; x1.0 persistence partially (0.5) -> +3.5 incl. margin.

exposures.mechanism: Diesel is ~50-60% of truck operating cost; +10% Brent (diesel pass-through ~ +6%) squeezes operator margins unless freight rates rise -> higher delinquencies. Empirical pack: -1.10 per SSU, t=-2.0 (agrees). Weight -1.0 after allowing for freight pass-through.

exposures.mechanism: Freight volumes, vehicle utilisation and MSME credit demand scale with GDP; +1pp GDP -> ~+1.5pp AUM growth and lower credit cost; multiplied by high operating leverage. Beta ~1.5 to market (pack).
